name: tree-simulation
description: Self-organizing trees in a 2D world: an interactive procedural growth simulator
author: Edward Barker

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p src/core && tsc -p src/worker && tsc -p src/web && tsc -p src/wasm && tsc -p cli && tsc -p .
scripts.rust:check: cd rust && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked -p tree-core --all-targets --features parity,threads -- -D warnings && RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+simd128' cargo clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --target-dir target/clippy-wasm -p tree-wasm --features testing -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked -q && cargo test --locked -q -p tree-core --features parity && cargo test --locked -q -p tree-core --features parity,threads
scripts.check: npm run build:wasm && npm run rust:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build:garden: vite build -c vite.garden.config.ts && node cli/garden-size.ts && node cli/first-paint.ts
